units.source_text: 我到学校向柏木打听了店铺的地点和名称。

en.t: I went to the school and asked Kashiwagi for the shop's location and name.

units.source_text: 柏木不问缘由就告诉了我。

en.t: Kashiwagi told me without asking the reason.

units.source_text: 当天我赶到那店铺，看见了无计其数的像明信片大小的批园名妓的照片。

en.t: That same day I hurried to the shop and saw countless postcard-sized photographs of famous Gion geisha.
